description: This source file contains unit tests for the MessageTap class in the org.eclipse.hono.util package. It verifies the behavior of message consumers and notification consumers in response to message events, using the JUnit testing framework.

classes.name: MessageTapTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing MessageTap's consumer behavior with Messages

methods.name: testTapCallsMessageConsumer
methods.description: Tests that the MessageTap's consumer correctly calls the message consumer when a message is accepted.

methods.name: testTapCallsNotificationDeviceReadyToDeliverConsumer
methods.description: Tests that the notification consumer is called when a message indicates command readiness, verifying both message and notification consumers are invoked.

methods.name: testTapCallsNotificationDeviceReadyToDeliverConsumerForEmptyEvent
methods.description: Tests that the notification consumer is called for an empty message indicating command readiness, verifying both consumers are invoked.

methods.name: createTestMessage
methods.description: Helper method to create a test message with optional content type and payload.

methods.name: createTestMessageWithoutBody
methods.description: Helper method to create a test message without a body.
